title: Pattern Matching
definition: Advanced string algorithms like KMP (Knuth-Morris-Pratt) or Rabin-Karp allow searching for a substring pattern of length M inside a text of length N in O(N + M) time instead of O(N * M).
simpleExplanation: Using clever math to find a specific word inside an entire dictionary without having to start over every time you make a mistake.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Pattern Matching (KMP).
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Pattern Matching (KMP) to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Pattern Matching (KMP) (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Pattern Matching (KMP) for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Pattern Matching (KMP) in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
